prompt: Which statements about profiling Go programs are true?
explanation: The recommended approach is to measure first with a profiler rather than guess at hot paths.

options.text: go tool pprof lets you inspect top, list, and flame graph views of a profile
sync.Pool can reduce allocations by reusing objects
go test -benchmem reports memory allocations per operation
Guessing at performance bottlenecks without measuring first is the recommended approach
